sources.name: Moseley, Markham & Nissen-Meyer (2021), Finite Basis Physics-Informed Neural Networks
sources.text: Primary reference. This lesson preserves overlapping windowed subnetworks and local coordinate normalisation, but uses compact C2 polynomial windows, hard zero endpoints and joint global optimisation in a tiny CPU adaptation.

sources.name: Primary sections4.1–4.4: ansatz, windows, scheduling and parallel training
sources.text: The original sigmoid-window experiments and detached-neighbour parallel schedule are not reproduced. Our code differentiates the complete globally summed field and trains all subnetworks jointly; no scaling or parallel speedup is claimed.

sources.name: Twelve executed CPU controls and saved local contributions
sources.text: Four representations, three seeds, equal292 parameter counts, all final checkpoints. Source and reference match the previous lesson, but hard boundaries and architectures differ, preventing a direct ranking against Paper12 results.
